description: DeepAgents agent with one tool, traced by OpenInference's LangChain instrumentation.
notes: Only LangChainInstrumentor is enabled, the same row as LangChain and LangGraph; DeepAgents has no instrumentor of its own. create_deep_agent wraps ChatOpenAI, pointed at the mock, with one tool, and the built-in file and sub-agent tools are sent on the wire. The tree is the LangGraph one: LangGraph [chain] root, PatchToolCallsMiddleware.before_agent [agent], model [chain] over ChatOpenAI [llm], tools [chain] over get_weather [tool], then model [chain] over ChatOpenAI [llm], and _ParentNotifierMiddleware.after_agent [agent]. The two middleware spans are typed agent although they are plumbing; the page says so. Nothing in a column identifies DeepAgents; ls_integration=deepagents stays in the metadata attribute. Run, message, and checkpoint ids are pinned to a counter so a recapture stays stable, as in langgraph-agent.
